limitations: This reconciles the supplied proofread Part II with the existing website; it is not a new independent audit of every historical claim.
New biography and directive references and the updated Lwów/Kovno museum passages were inspected; retained references use the existing source register.
Soviet records are published transcriptions; original archival files and all cited print editions were not independently inspected.
Historical map data is unchanged. The main canvas already uses the exact header sepia #FAF3E3.
